tool_architecture.primary_function: LAN-based Push Notification System for CDC Updates
tool_architecture.description: Engineered to bypass reliance on external servers and mitigate the risk of third-party data interception during highly confidential placement communications. Operates exclusively over the Local Area Network (LAN) using customized IP protocols to deliver push notifications directly to student mobile devices.
tool_architecture.deployment_methodology: LAN-only deployment within IIT KGP campus network
notification_channels: LAN-based push notifications to mobile devices

operational_mechanics.trigger_mechanism: Monitors CDC updates and segregates into distinct channels
operational_mechanics.scheduling_algorithm: Pushes critical reminders precisely thirty minutes prior to CDC deadlines
operational_mechanics.security_advantage: No data leaves the campus LAN, eliminating third-party interception risk

compliance_and_risk_warnings: Operates within campus LAN reducing external exposure
Still subject to institutional policies regarding automated CDC access
